summary: The main preview now adds zoom, mouse-wheel control, rotation, and panning, alongside a complete bilingual GitHub presentation.
changelog: Adds zoom out, zoom in, editable 1–500% control, fit-to-window, actual size, left/right rotation, scrollbars, and drag-to-pan to the main document preview.
Lets the mouse wheel change zoom while the pointer is over the main preview, while keeping the reprint preview physically faithful and free of manual rotation.
Keeps Apply and Start using PyCUPS labels stable while the blocking CUPS restart dialog communicates progress.
Adds symbolic icons to primary actions and removes unnecessary ellipses from Export original and Reprint.
Rebuilds the English and Brazilian Portuguese GitHub documentation with screenshots, use cases, privacy guidance, installation steps, translations, and search-friendly descriptions.
Adds GitHub Actions CI and package builds, Dependabot, issue forms, a pull-request template, security and support policies, editor defaults, attributes, and ignore rules.
Includes the complete screenshot gallery and documentation in the reproducible GitHub source ZIP and extends regression coverage for preview geometry and packaging.
